title: Read tape contents at a position
statement: Given a configuration of an $m$-tape Turing machine with Boolean work-tape symbols and states in the disjoint union of read phases and optional Boolean values, a tape index $s$, a new state label $l$, a new input-head position $ip$, and a natural number $k$, define a new configuration by setting its state to $l$, its input-head position to $ip$, tape $s$ to the tape whose contents encode the binary digits of $k$, and the head position on tape $s$ to $0$. All other work tapes and head positions, and the output, are unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: The starting configuration has $m$ work tapes, Boolean tape symbols, and states in the stated disjoint union.
$l$ is a state label in that disjoint union.
